metadata.Description: This paper presents a method for learning word embeddings that capture semantic relationships between words. The approach utilizes recursive neural networks to create representations that are sensitive to the context in which words appear.
metadata.Paper Title: Better Word Representations with Recursive Neural Networks
metadata.Venue Title: Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing
metadata.Abstract: This paper presents a method for learning word embeddings that capture semantic relationships between words. The approach utilizes recursive neural networks to create representations that are sensitive to the context in which words appear. The results show that the proposed method outperforms existing approaches on a variety of word similarity tasks.
